mapper.sql: id , one_code_ext_id, product_serial_number, product_id, project_id, monomer_id, area_id, product_type, tech_capp_product_task_work_type
mapper.select:
select tccpt.id as id, tccpt.tech_capp_product_task_work_type as techCappProductTaskWorkType, ext.sort_number as productCodeNumber from tech_capp_craft_product_task as tccpt
left join tech_artifact_ext as ext on tccpt.one_code_ext_id = ext.id
left join tech_assemble_ext as ext on tccpt.one_code_ext_id = ext.id
where tccpt.bool_delete_enum = 0 and ext.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tccpt.product_id = #{productId} order by tccpt.tech_capp_product_task_work_type asc

select tccppt.id as id, tcccscppl.welding_craft_parameter_pass as weldingCraftParameterPass, tcccs.welding_base_welding_method as weldingBaseWeldingMethod, tcccscppl.welding_material_trademark as weldingMaterialTrademark, tcccscppl.welding_craft_parameter_rod_or_wire_designation as weldingCraftParameterRodOrWireDesignation, tcccscppl.voltage as voltage, tcccscppl.electricity as electricity, tcccscppl.welding_speed as weldingSpeed, tcccscppl.welding_craft_parameter_welding_flux_or_shielding_gas as weldingCraftParameterWeldingFluxOrShieldingGas, tcccscppl.welding_craft_parameter_shielding_gas_flow as weldingCraftParameterShieldingGasFlow, tccppt.tech_capp_product_task_work_type as techCappProductTaskWorkType, tccppt.equiment_serial_number as equimentSerialNumber, tccppt.equiment_code as equimentCode, tccppt.equiment_name as equimentName, tccppt.is_pause as isPause, tccppt.welding_gun_code as weldingGunCode, tcccs.id as techCappCraftCardStorehouseId from tech_capp_craft_product_pass_task as tccppt left join tech_capp_craft_card_storehouse_craft_parameter_pass_link as tcccscppl on tccppt.tech_capp_craft_card_storehouse_craft_parameter_pass_link_id = tcccscppl.id left join tech_capp_craft_card_storehouse as tcccs on tcccs.id = tcccscppl.tech_capp_craft_card_storehouse_id where tccppt.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tccppt.tech_capp_craft_product_weld_task_id = #{id}
